explanations.authorised-960427: 4.00g is correct. Na=23, NaOH=40. 2 mol Na(46g) produces 2 mol NaOH(80g). 2.3g Na is 1/20 of 46g, so mass NaOH = 80/20 = 4.0g. The important step is to keep the mole ratio from the balanced equation intact before converting to mass or volume; the coefficients tell you the reacting proportions.
explanations.authorised-960428: 369.23 cm3 is correct. P1V1=P2V2. 300x800=650xV2. V2=240000/650=369.23 cm3. For gas-law questions, identify which variables are constant first, then choose the law that links the changing quantities; always use consistent units.
explanations.authorised-960429: 11 is correct. [OH-]=10^-3, pOH=3. pH=14-3=11. The deciding idea is the acid/base property being tested: identify the relevant H+ or OH− concentration, strength, or neutralisation relationship before selecting the answer.
explanations.authorised-960430: dissolution in water, filtration and evaporation is correct. Sugar dissolves in water, sulphur doesn't. explanations.authorised-960431: 44% is correct. Molar mass = 65+32+64+126=287g/mol. %water = 126/287x100=43.9% ~44%. The important step is to keep the mole ratio from the balanced equation intact before converting to mass or volume; the coefficients tell you the reacting proportions.
explanations.authorised-960432: 168 cm3 is correct. CaCO3+2HCl->CaCl2+H2O+CO2, ratio 1:2. 0.0075 mol CaCO3 exactly matches 0.015 mol HCl. CO2 = 0.0075mol x 22.4 = 0.168dm3 = 168cm3. The important step is to keep the mole ratio from the balanced equation intact before converting to mass or volume; the coefficients tell you the reacting proportions.
explanations.authorised-960433: Azimuthal is correct. Principal quantum number (n) gives the shell. Azimuthal (l) breaks shells into sub-shells/orbitals (s,p,d,f). explanations.authorised-960435: Cu is correct. Copper is famously purified by electrolysis: impure copper anode, pure copper cathode, electrical energy moves pure copper to the cathode. explanations.authorised-960437: 17.1% is correct. Ca(NO3)2, molar mass=40+2(14+48)=164. 2N=28g. %N=28/164x100=17.1%. The important step is to keep the mole ratio from the balanced equation intact before converting to mass or volume; the coefficients tell you the reacting proportions.

explanations.authorised-960674: flood is correct. 'Blood' is pronounced /blʌd/ — the 'oo' gives the /ʌ/ sound. 'Flood' is also pronounced /flʌd/. This is a classic JAMB rhyming/vowel trap. explanations.authorised-960680: /ʃ/ is correct. 'Ship' /SIp/, 'shop' /Sɒp/, and 'share' /Seə/ all begin with the voiceless palato-alveolar fricative /S/ (the 'sh' sound).
